title: tu / tout
tip: For u, round your lips as if to say “oo”, then say “ee”. For ou, just say “oo”.

title: vin / vent
tip: Both vowels go through the nose. Vin is said with the mouth flatter and more open; vent with it rounder and further back.

title: The French r
tip: Make the r at the back of the throat, like a light gargle, not with the tip of the tongue.
